title: Introduce legacy_compat_mode flag, validator, and perf tests for embedding distance modes
creator: Marco Chen
description:
Problem: Some customers (legacy clients and internal reranker variants) rely on unnormalized embedding vectors and dot-product scoring. Newer model variants and the default embed pipeline normalize vectors by default, which changes absolute score ranges and can cause rerank ordering regressions for callers that expect legacy dot semantics.

Goal: Provide a safe, observable compatibility mode and server-side validation so we can correct distance-mode behavior (dot vs cosine) without breaking existing customers. Implement a request-level legacy_compat_mode flag plus a runtime validator that detects likely-misconfigured clients and applies a deterministic shim only when needed. Also add microbenchmarks and end-to-end perf tests to ensure latency impact is <1% p50/p95 for rerank flows.

Scope: runtime change to scoring path and request header handling, tests and dashboards, migration plan and docs. Avoid changing client libraries in this ticket; clients will be encouraged to opt-in to normalized mode via SDKs in follow-up work.
acceptance_criteria: Introduce a request header or JSON field (x-embed-compat or legacy_compat_mode) that can be set per-call and is honored by the rerank endpoint
Runtime validator emits a warning metric when it detects mismatch between declared mode and embedding norms (e.g., L2 norm significantly != 1.0)
Server applies deterministic shim that converts older dot-based scoring to be stable when models send normalized vectors, preserving ordering for legacy clients in >=95% of test cases
Performance: added logic increases rerank p95 latency by <=1% on standard test workload; CI microbench included
Migration docs and a rollback plan exist; canary rollout plan defined (5% -> 20% -> 100%) with monitoring knobs
Unit/integration tests and a Github PR link referenced in this ticket
tasks: Design API: header name, JSON param, and precedence rules with SDK teams
Implement runtime validator and metric (embeddings.norm_check, embeddings.mode_mismatch)
Implement compatibility shim in rerank scoring path behind feature flag
Write microbench harness and perf tests comparing no-shim vs shim latencies
Add dashboards and alerts for rerank score drift and mismatch metric
Draft migration guide and update SDK docs
Create canary rollout plan and run initial 5% canary with customer-facing tests
